title: Which interfaces need to align when connecting a roller-hearth furnace to a buyer-supplied quench press?
summary: Rapid furnace discharge covers only part of hot-workpiece transfer; downstream cooling still needs a defined interface. Jiangsu Suneng Industrial Furnace Co., Ltd.'s gas-fired roller-hearth quenching-furnace documents dated 13 March 2024 propose rapid discharge after heating, while assigning the quench press, cooling system and settling/deslagging to the buyer. Spray-quenching method is marked “to be determined”. This is an interface reference, not a confirmed or delivered complete press-quenching line.
